name: codex-folders
description: Organize Codex chats in project folders and recall shared project context.

interface.longDescription: Organize saved Codex conversations into folders and projects, move chats, and maintain shared project instructions and revisioned memory through fourteen local MCP tools. Search and read source messages within a project. Requires the standalone Codex Folders CLI, Node 24+, and compatible local Codex chat APIs. Terminal /folders, /resume, and /resumedbg commands additionally require Codex Command Extensions. Linux is verified; macOS is untested and the Windows terminal backend is unavailable. The official-directory ZIP excludes lifecycle hooks, so project context must be loaded and saved explicitly with tools; automatic hook injection is available only through the separate manual installation. Community project by Cheaux; not maintained or endorsed by OpenAI.
defaultPrompt: Organize my Codex chats into project folders.
Load the shared context for this project.
